032/**
033 * An output that is designed for writing to a file.
034 */
035public interface FileOutput extends LogOutput {
036
037        /**
038         * Default file buffer size. This size was chosen based on Logbacks default.
039         */
040        public static final int DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = 8192;
041
042        @Override
043        default OutputType type() {
044                return OutputType.FILE;
045        }
046
047        /**
048         * Creates a file output provider from lambda builder and uses the config properties
049         * from the returned log provider.
050         * @param consumer builder lambda.
051         * @return provider.
052         */
053        public static LogProvider<FileOutput> of(Consumer<FileOutputBuilder> consumer) {
054                return (s, c) -> {
055                        var builder = new FileOutputBuilder(s);
056                        consumer.accept(builder);
057                        builder.fromProperties(c.properties());
058                        return builder.build();
059                };
060        }
061
062        /**
063         * Create output from provider ref. This is mostly an internal call.
064         * @param ref file provider ref.
065         * @return provider.
066         */
067        public static LogProvider<LogOutput> of(LogProviderRef ref) {
068                return (s, c) -> {
069                        return provide(ref, s, c.properties());
070                };
071        }
072
073        private static LogOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogProperties properties) {
074                FileOutputBuilder b = new FileOutputBuilder(name);
075                var uri = ref.uri();
076                LogProperties combined;
077                if (uri.getQuery() != null) {
078                        combined = LogProperties.of(uri, b.propertyPrefix(), properties, ref.keyOrNull());
079                        String s = uri.toString();
080                        int index = s.indexOf('?');
081                        s = s.substring(0, index);
082                        uri = URI.create(s);
083                        uri = Paths.get(uri).toUri();
084                }
085                else {
086                        combined = properties;
087                }
088                b.uri(uri);
089                b.fromProperties(combined);
090                return b.build();
091        }
092
093        /**
094         * Creates file output.
095         * @param name name of output not file name.
096         * @param uri file uri.
097         * @param fileName file name.
098         * @param append whether or not to append to existing file.
099         * @param prudent logback prudent mode where files are locked on each write.
100         * @param bufferSize buffer size in bytes.
101         * @return file output.
102         * @throws UncheckedIOException if file not found.
103         */
104        @SuppressWarnings("resource")
105        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.OUTPUT_PREFIX)
106        public static FileOutput of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable URI uri, @Nullable String fileName,
107                        @Nullable Boolean append, @Nullable Boolean prudent,
108                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE") Integer bufferSize) throws UncheckedIOException {
109                boolean prudent_ = prudent == null ? false : prudent;
110                boolean append_ = append == null ? true : append;
111                IOSupplier<FileOutput> supplier = () -> {
112                        File file;
113                        URI uri_ = uri;
114                        if (fileName != null) {
115                                file = new File(fileName);
116                                uri_ = file.toURI();
117                        }
118                        else if (uri_ != null) {
119                                file = new File(uri_);
120                        }
121                        else {
122                                throw new IOException("fileName and uri cannot both be unset.");
123                        }
124                        createMissingParentDirectories(file);
125                        FileOutputStream stream;
126                        try {
127                                stream = new FileOutputStream(file, append_);
128                        }
129                        catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
130                                throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
131                        }
132                        if (prudent_) {
133                                return new FileChannelOutput(uri_, stream.getChannel());
134                        }
135                        OutputStream s;
136                        Objects.requireNonNull(bufferSize);
137                        if (bufferSize <= 0) {
138                                s = stream;
139                        }
140                        else {
141                                s = new BufferedOutputStream(stream, bufferSize);
142                        }
143                        return new FileOutputStreamOutput(uri_, s);
144                };
145
146                return new ReopenableFileOutput(supplier);
147        }
148
149        /**
150         * Creates the parent directories of a file. If parent directories not specified in
151         * file's path, then nothing is done and this returns gracefully.
152         * @param file file whose parent directories (if any) should be created
153         * @return {@code true} if either no parents were specified, or if all parent
154         * directories were created successfully; {@code false} otherwise
155         */
156        private static boolean createMissingParentDirectories(File file) {
157                File parent = file.getParentFile();
158                if (parent == null) {
159                        // Parent directory not specified, therefore it's a request to
160                        // create nothing. Done! ;)
161                        return true;
162                }
163
164                // File.mkdirs() creates the parent directories only if they don't
165                // already exist; and it's okay if they do.
166                parent.mkdirs();
167                return parent.exists();
168        }
169
170}
171
172@FunctionalInterface
173interface IOSupplier<T> {
174
175        T _get() throws IOException;
176
177        default T get() throws UncheckedIOException {
178                try {
179                        return _get();
180                }
181                catch (IOException e) {
182                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
183                }
184        }
185
186}
187
188class ReopenableFileOutput implements ForwardingOutput, FileOutput {
189
190        private volatile FileOutput fileOutput;
191
192        private @Nullable LogConfig config;
193
194        private final IOSupplier<FileOutput> supplier;
195
196        public ReopenableFileOutput(IOSupplier<FileOutput> supplier) {
197                super();
198                this.supplier = supplier;
199                this.fileOutput = supplier.get();
200        }
201
202        @Override
203        public void start(LogConfig config) {
204                this.config = config;
205                fileOutput.start(config);
206        }
207
208        @Override
209        public @Nullable LogOutput delegate() {
210                return fileOutput;
211        }
212
213        @Override
214        public URI uri() throws UnsupportedOperationException {
215                return fileOutput.uri();
216        }
217
218        @Override
219        public OutputType type() {
220                return fileOutput.type();
221        }
222
223        @Override
224        public BufferHints bufferHints() {
225                return fileOutput.bufferHints();
226        }
227
228        @Override
229        public Status reopen() {
230                this.fileOutput.close();
231                this.fileOutput = supplier.get();
232                var config = this.config;
233                if (config != null) {
234                        this.fileOutput.start(config);
235                }
236                return Status.StandardStatus.OK;
237        }
238
239}
240
241class FileOutputStreamOutput extends LogOutput.AbstractOutputStreamOutput implements FileOutput {
242
243        protected FileOutputStreamOutput(URI uri, OutputStream outputStream) {
244                super(uri, outputStream);
245        }
246
247}
248
249class FileChannelOutput implements FileOutput {
250
251        protected final URI uri;
252
253        protected final FileChannel channel;
254
255        public FileChannelOutput(URI uri, FileChannel channel) {
256                super();
257                this.uri = uri;
258                this.channel = channel;
259        }
260
261        @Override
262        public URI uri() throws UnsupportedOperationException {
263                return uri;
264        }
265
266        @Override
267        public void write(LogEvent event, byte[] bytes, int off, int len, ContentType contentType) {
268                write(event, ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes, off, len), contentType);
269        }
270
271        @Override
272        public void write(LogEvent event, ByteBuffer buffer, ContentType contentType) {
273                try {
274
275                        // Clear any current interrupt (see LOGBACK-875)
276                        boolean interrupted = Thread.interrupted();
277
278                        FileLock fileLock = null;
279                        try {
280                                fileLock = channel.lock();
281                                long position = channel.position();
282                                long size = channel.size();
283                                if (size != position) {
284                                        channel.position(size);
285                                }
286                                channel.write(buffer);
287
288                        }
289                        catch (IOException e) {
290                                MetaLog.error(FileChannelOutput.class, e);
291                        }
292                        finally {
293                                if (fileLock != null && fileLock.isValid()) {
294                                        fileLock.release();
295                                }
296                                if (interrupted) {
297                                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
298                                }
299                        }
300                }
301                catch (IOException e) {
302                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
303                }
304        }
305
306        @Override
307        public void close() {
308                try {
309                        channel.close();
310                }
311                catch (IOException e) {
312                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
313                }
314        }
315
316        @Override
317        public void flush() {
318                try {
319                        channel.force(false);
320                }
321                catch (IOException e) {
322                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
323                }
324        }
325
326        @Override
327        public WriteMethod bufferHints() {
328                return WriteMethod.BYTE_BUFFER;
329        }
330
331}
